newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isetan says will retain rights under Barney's plan.
newsitem.headline: Isetan says will retain rights under Barney's plan.

text.p: Japanese department store Isetan Co said on Wednesday that its agreement with Saks Holdings Inc to reorganise Barney's Inc would allow Isetan to retain its rights to the U.S. retailer's real estate and operations in Japan.
On Tuesday, Isetan and Saks said in New York that they agreed to a joint plan of reorganisation for Barney's under which Saks would acquire Barney's stock and assets for about $290 million.

Barney's said in a separate statement that it had received the Saks-Isetan "term-sheet" and was reviewing it. Barney's also said it would ask the court on Thursday for a 60-day extension, until July 7, of the period in which it has the exclusive right to submit its own reorganisation plan.
